meta.name: user-auth-flows
meta.description: Use when changing backend user auth, verification codes, token persistence, temp-user behavior, or auth-provider integration. Keep provider dispatch and credential state centralized.

copy.tagline: 管理用户认证流程与身份提供者集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要实现或修改用户认证逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Manage user authentication flows and identity provider integration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often implement or modify user authentication logic

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照仓库、令牌存储和认证工厂的路径来修改用户认证逻辑，并确保验证码、令牌持久化、临时用户行为等同步更新。
howto.when: 当你要求修改后端用户认证、验证码、令牌持久化、临时用户行为或认证提供者集成时触发。

say.text: 帮我修改邮箱验证码的过期时间。
添加一个新的认证提供者，比如微信登录。
修复令牌持久化中的登出逻辑。
say.note: Claude 会同步更新前后端认证载荷。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will modify user authentication logic following the paths of repository, token store, and auth factory, ensuring verification codes, token persistence, temp-user behavior, etc. are updated together.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to change backend user auth, verification codes, token persistence, temp-user behavior, or auth-provider integration.

say_en.text: Help me change the expiration time of email verification codes.
say_en.note: Claude will start from core files like repository.py.

say_en.text: Add a new auth provider, like WeChat login.
say_en.note: Claude will update provider dispatch and credential state.

say_en.text: Fix the logout logic in token persistence.
say_en.note: Claude will update frontend and backend auth payloads together.
